scope: Independent algebra/code check of prepared-polynomial defect identity and conditional inverse bound; not blanket audit of callback implementations

findings.statement: D(C)=kappa*q_norm(C)+E(C) coefficient signs and degrees match stored implementation.
The E polynomial includes rounded alpha and synthetic division; eta<1 gives finite-dimensional inverse bound.
Degree d requires d-1 chart actions plus one original residual action per iteration.
Residual allowance covers both original callback error and full floating residual arithmetic; stated explicitly in N1_N2.md.
